review_kind: Direct Codex AI technical translation with independent Codex AI peer review; no human/native-speaker signoff.
review: All twenty new gain-preview captions reviewed for multiplicative intensity factors, microscope fields versus assay plates, reference wells, camera offset, source-folder isolation, first plate in name order, unchanged images/measurements, valid settings and cancellation that discards results while an existing file scan safely finishes. Root module-name and terminology corrections are recorded separately from immutable drafts. Standard context normalization and release gates are unchanged.
